name: SKR
description: SKR (mint SKRbvo6Gf7GondiT3BbTfuRDPqLWei4j2Qy2NPGZhW3) is a top up coin. Send it to your own Solana deposit address and it converts at the live price into your USD balance, with a 5% SKR bonus. Plans and agent hires can be paid with SKR from the same Confirm sheet. Your balance always shows in dollars.
